abilities.name: Devourer of Magics
abilities.effect: If this **^^Manifestation^^** destroyed any enemy **^^Manifestations^^** this turn, Heal (6) this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this **^^Manifestation^^**, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy **^^Manifestations^^**, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: End Given Form
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this **^^Manifestation^^** passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
abilities.declare: For each part of this **^^Manifestation^^**, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this **^^Manifestation^^** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this **^^Manifestation^^** passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** cannot use **^^Charge^^** or **^^Fight^^** abilities. In addition, when this **^^Manifestation^^** moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
If there are any friendly **^^Wizards^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^**, pick 1 of the following effects:
***Increase Time Flow***: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
***Decrease Time Flow***: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **^^Wizards^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

weapons.Ability: Shoot in Combat, Anti-**^^WAR MACHINE^^** (+1 Rend)
weapons.name: Burning Breath

abilities.name: Burning Up
abilities.effect: Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this **^^Manifestation^^** (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this **^^Manifestation^^**'s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation
abilities.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 **maelstrom points**. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect:
Give this **^^Manifestation^^** 1 **maelstrom point** each time:
• This **^^Manifestation^^** is set up.
• A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
• A model is slain within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.
This **^^Manifestation^^** can have a maximum of 6 **maelstrom points** at once.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this **^^Manifestation^^**, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a **^^Move^^** ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Infantry Wizard Hero^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this **^^Manifestation^^**'s attacks.

abilities.name: Restored Vigour
abilities.effect: **Heal (3)** this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Bounteous Healing
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: **Heal (3)** the target.

abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Pulled to the Grave
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this **^^Manifestation^^** passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect:
When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other.
Each part of this **^^Manifestation^^** is armed with **Tendrils of Light and Shadow**.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Arcane Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-**^^Summon Spell^^** ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this **^^Manifestation^^** instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this **^^Manifestation^^** instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Lord of Murder Incarnate
abilities.effect: This **^^Manifestation^^** is affected by the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability as if it were a unit.

abilities.name: Wrath of Khaine
abilities.effect: Add X to the Attacks characteristic of this **^^Manifestation^^**'s melee weapons, where X is the number of times you have used the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability this battle, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Crushing Coils
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** or **^^Monster^^** in combat with this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Bind and Bite
abilities.effect: This unit's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ if the target of those attacks has **^^Strike-Last^^**.

abilities.name: Unnatural Edge
abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: If any damage points are allocated to the target this phase by this **^^Manifestation^^**'s combat attacks, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Locus of the Murder God
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Infantry^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Roaring Rune-fire
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 6" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract 3 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Flamescarred
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this **^^Manifestation^^**'s attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the end of your next turn.

abilities.name: Magma Blast
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this **^^Manifestation^^**'s shooting attacks if the target unit has 10 or more models. Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls instead if the target unit has 15 or more models.

abilities.name: Crushing Coil
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Manifestations^^** that target an **ensnared** enemy unit.

abilities.name: Watery Clutch
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, the target is **ensnared** for the rest of the turn.
A unit cannot use commands while it is **ensnared**.

abilities.name: Surrender to the Sea
abilities.effect: When this **^^Manifestation^^** is removed from play, each friendly **Abyssal Tendril** on the battlefield is automatically removed from play.

abilities.name: Grasping Tendrils
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if it is your turn.
On a 4+:
• You can remove 1 friendly **Abyssal Tendril** from the battlefield.
• If there are fewer than 2 friendly Abyssal Tendrils on the battlefield, you can set up an **Abyssal Tendril** wholly within 9" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Turn to Stone
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this **^^Manifestation^^**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If an enemy unit has at least 3 mortal damage inflicted on it by this ability this turn, it has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Sigil of Yngra
abilities.effect:
While a friendly unit with a Health characteristic of 10 or less is wholly inside the ring formed by this **^^Manifestation^^**:
• That unit is not visible to enemy units that are not within its combat range.
• Enemy abilities that would target this unit must target this **^^Manifestation^^** instead.

abilities.name: Reservoir of Power
abilities.effect:
Each time a unit (friendly or enemy) successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**, give this **^^Manifestation^^** 1 **arcane charge point**.
This **^^Manifestation^^** can have a maximum of 6 **arcane charge points**.

abilities.name: Release Arcane Charge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** or **^^Unbind^^** ability for a **^^Lumineth Realm-lords Wizard^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^**
abilities.effect: Add this **^^Manifestation^^**'s **arcane charge points** to the casting roll or unbinding roll. Then, reset this **^^Manifestation^^**'s arcane charge points to 0.

abilities.name: Tornado of Magic
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks made by enemy units while they are within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Arcane Enhancement
abilities.effect:
While the unit that was picked to be the target of the 'Summon Dais Arcanum' ability is on the platform of this **^^Manifestation^^**:
• That unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** and **^^Fly^^**.
• If that unit is a **^^Wizard^^**, add 1 to that unit's power level.
• That unit cannot use **^^Move^^** abilities and remains on this **^^Manifestation^^** each time it moves.
• If that unit is picked to make a pile-in move, move this **^^Manifestation^^** instead.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to that unit, measure to this **^^Manifestation^^** instead.
• This **^^Manifestation^^** cannot be picked to be the target of abilities other than **^^Banish^^** abilities. 
If this **^^Manifestation^^** is banished, before removing it from the battlefield, set up the unit on its platform on the battlefield within 3" of it. That unit can only be set up in combat with units it was already in combat with when this **^^Manifestation^^** was banished. If it is not possible to set up that unit, it is destroyed.
If the unit on the platform is removed from the battlefield, immediately remove this **^^Manifestation^^** from play.

abilities.name: Burning Vengeance
abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** was summoned this phase, pick any number of enemy units within 6" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Arcane Disruption
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **^^Wizards^^** while they are within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Eldritch Hunters
abilities.effect: If this **^^Manifestation^^** is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-**^^Wizard^^** non-**^^Priest^^** units and more than 3" from all enemy **^^Wizards^^** and enemy **^^Priests^^**.

abilities.name: Feed on Eldritch Energy
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls, unbinding rolls, chanting rolls and banishment rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with this **^^Manifestation^^**

abilities.name: Vengeful Terrors
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are within 6" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Anger The Hive
abilities.effect: If this **^^Manifestation^^** was not set up this turn, add 10 to the Attacks characteristic of this **^^Manifestation^^**'s ranged weapons for the rest of the phase, but all of the shooting attacks it makes this phase must target an enemy unit within 9" of it.

abilities.name: Hatred's Edge
abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit with a starting size greater than 1 that is in combat with this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. On an 8+, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: Sigil of Doom
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 8" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target. Then, pick a passive **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability that you have not unlocked this battle.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the **blood tithe points** cost of the chosen ability, until the start of your next turn, the effects of that ability apply to the target as if it had been unlocked.

abilities.name: Hexgorgers
abilities.effect: For each part of this **^^Manifestation^^** that is within 8" of a **^^Wizard^^** (friendly or enemy), subtract 1 from casting rolls for that **^^Wizard^^**.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect:
When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** moves, both its parts must end within 8" of each other. Each part of this **^^Manifestation^^** is armed with a **Stream of Molten Blood**.

abilities.name: Compendium of Darkness
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch Wizard^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect:
The target can immediately use a **^^Spell^^** ability from the Lore of Change or the Lore of Fate.
**Designer's Note**: *That spell does not count towards the number of **^^Spell^^** or **^^Banish^^** abilities the target can use this phase.*

abilities.name: Radiant Transmogrification
abilities.declare: This **^^Manifestation^^** must use this ability in each hero phase. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll 2 dice, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn:
**1** No effect.
**2-3** **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy target.
**4** Friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** targets can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if they used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn. Enemy targets cannot use **^^Run^^** abilities.
**5** Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
**6** Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by  friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** targets. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.

abilities.name: Jaws of Fate
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Snapping Jaws** for each **fate point** you have.

abilities.name: Irresistible Lure
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Move^^** ability for a unit within 18" of and visible to this **^^Manifestation^^**
abilities.effect: If that enemy unit does not end the move closer to this **^^Manifestation^^** than it was at the start of the move, inflict D6 mortal damage on it after the **^^Move^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Flensing Tongues
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Until this **^^Manifestation^^** is banished or destroyed, the target is **tongue-tied** while it is within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**. While the target is **tongue-tied**:


• It cannot use **^^Run^^** abilities.
• Your opponent must roll a D6 instead of a D3 when determining the amount of mortal damage inflicted on the target when it uses a **^^Retreat^^** ability.

abilities.name: Exquisite Agony
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Toll of Doom
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: More-more Rats
abilities.effect: **Heal (D6)** this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Warp Lightning Bolts
abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** was not set up this turn, pick each enemy unit within 6" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Warp Vortex
abilities.effect: Subtract 2 from run rolls and charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of this **^^Manifestation^^**. In addition, if an enemy unit passes across this **^^Manifestation^^** and/or the round-cornered triangle formed by drawing a line around all the bases of the **^^Manifestation^^**'s parts, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit after the **^^Move^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Empowered by Atrocity
abilities.effect: If 2 or more units (friendly or enemy) were destroyed this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.name: Debilitating Shockwave
abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any models in the target unit are slain by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fuelled by Sorcery
abilities.effect:
Each time a spell is successfully cast by a unit within 12" of this **^^Manifestation^^**, give this **^^Manifestation^^** 1 **ruinous energy point**, to a maximum of 6.
Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Darkfire Torrent** for each ruinous energy point it has.
If this **^^Manifestation^^** is removed from play, all of its ruinous energy points are lost.
